title: AI haters won't like this
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
I'm working on a online game similar to GTA online but all the content is live-generated by players. Prompt your own sportscar, your own building, your own weapon, etc...  
what do you guys think of this idea? Is it something players would actually play?

  
How I use AI: 

* I use different AI apis like OpenAI, groq, gemini to generate in-game sprites on the fly.
* For the actual game development, I primarily used Claude and Claude Code (alongside Unity and Cursor). Claude wrote the core game logic, helped structure the multiplayer networking, and integrated the various AI APIs into the game engine.

  
You can try it here: [https://flair-3d.fly.dev/](https://flair-3d.fly.dev/)
